editor.install.ok.body: {name} — back to the launcher to see it on the grid.

editor.new.title: New wapp

editor.projects.empty:
No user-installed wapps yet.
Click "Create new wapp" to start one.

editor.ui.drop_blocks: Drop blocks from the palette here
editor.ui.inspector.hint: Click a block on the canvas to edit its properties.

editor.palette.label: Label

editor.translations.empty: No keys yet. Click "Extract @keys from UI" to scan the UI tab for references, or "Add key" to create one manually.
editor.settings.note: Changes are kept in memory while you edit. Click Save to write them to disk.

editor.settings.provides.help: Functionalities this wapp provides for other wapps to use.
editor.signing.no_profile: No profile — wapps will not be signed
